answer: Chained task lineage stops Sybils in four steps. First, every new job links to a prior verified job signed by a different client, so no script can invent history. Second, a chain branches only after ten links, with random peer audits monthly. Third, one forged link voids the whole chain and forfeits a $25 bond. Fourth, idle chains wither after sixty days, so fakes must keep working. Faking 1,000 agents needs 10,000 linked jobs plus $41,000 in bonds and fees, lost if caught. Trust grows like a lotus in a grove, each bloom echoing the last, like a stall whose regulars remember honest sales.
